comments.content: Initializing std::string_view from the temporary std::string returned by strprintf creates a dangling reference and is a type mismatch – std::string_view has no implicit conversion from std::string. Use std::string for `services` or build the header without an intermediate view.

Header formats services with FormatServices(networkinfo["localservicesnames"]) while the new helper is ServicesList and is used later for local services. This is inconsistent and likely wrong – FormatServices probably expects a bitfield, not the array of names, so use ServicesList here for consistency.
